WHY_I_FIT:
Business development at its core is about understanding what a client needs, structuring a solution, and closing the deal. I have been doing exactly that for four years in a different arena.

At **Gandhi & Co.**, I managed **50+ commercial dispute briefs** and personally conducted **30+ client consultations** where the stakes were not quarterly targets but legal outcomes worth crores. That experience taught me structured problem diagnosis, stakeholder persuasion under pressure, and rigorous follow through. I attended **100+ court hearings** where every argument was a live negotiation with judges, opposing counsel, and client expectations simultaneously.

My MBA from **IIM Sirmaur** sharpened the commercial lens. At **TATA AIG**, I benchmarked **3+ insurance distribution channels**, identifying underserved corporate segments. When I founded **Naraina Jewellers**, I personally negotiated **12+ vendor agreements** across Surat diamond factories, Mumbai bullion houses, and Delhi wholesale markets, securing direct manufacturer MOQs that bypassed intermediary markups.

I read financial statements, build Excel models, and structure commercial proposals. I have closed deals under statutory limitation deadlines more unforgiving than any sales quarter. And I score in the **top 98.66%** on quantitative aptitude (3rd International Mathematics Olympiad).

I am looking to channel this negotiation, analytical, and client management intensity into business development where I can drive revenue and build lasting commercial partnerships.
